<div class="sd" data-ver="1009sd-en">
 <div class="sd-app">
  <div class="sd-top"><span class="sd-logo">TOMODACHI JAPAN</span></div>
  <div class="sd-body">
   <div class="sd-screen" id="sdIntro">
    <div class="sd-title"><small>TEACHER MATCH QUIZ</small><b>Which Teacher Fits Your Child?</b><span>先生タイプ診断</span></div>
    <div class="sd-hero"><img decoding="async" src="https://tomodachi-japan.nijin.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/ChatGPT-Image-2026年9月30日-22_16_48.png" alt="Teacher match quiz"></div>
    <div class="sd-faces" id="sdFaces"></div>
    <p class="sd-lead">Answer 7 quick questions and find the<br>Tomodachi Japan teacher who fits your child best.</p>
    <p class="sd-time">⏱ Takes about 1 minute</p>
    <button type="button" class="sd-main" id="sdStart">Start the quiz ▶</button>
   </div>
   <div class="sd-screen" id="sdQuiz" hidden>
    <div class="sd-qno">Question <em id="sdNo">01</em> / 07</div>
    <div class="sd-bar"><i id="sdBar"></i></div>
    <h2 class="sd-q" id="sdQ"></h2>
    <div class="sd-opts" id="sdOpts"></div>
    <div class="sd-cheer" id="sdCheer"></div>
   </div>
   <div class="sd-screen sd-wait" id="sdWait" hidden>
    <div class="sd-ring"><svg class="sd-dots" viewBox="0 0 230 230" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="115" cy="115" r="108" stroke="#cfe8fa" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="1 9"></circle><circle cx="115" cy="115" r="108" stroke="#2f9be0" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="1 13 1 13 1 13 1 13 1 13 1 13 1 400"></circle></svg>
     <div class="sd-photo" id="sdPhoto"><span><small>Finding your teacher</small>Matching…</span></div>
     <div class="sd-ok" id="sdOk" hidden><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="84" height="84" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" fill="none" stroke="#2f9be0" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div></div>
    <p class="sd-thanks">Thank you for your answers!</p>
    <p>We are finding the Tomodachi Japan teacher<br>who matches your child</p>
   </div>
   <div class="sd-screen" id="sdRes" hidden>
    <h2 class="sd-res-h">Your Result</h2>
    <div class="sd-card" id="sdCard">
     <small>YOUR TEACHER IS…</small>
     <div class="sd-avatar" id="resultAvatar"></div>
     <div class="sd-name" id="resultName"></div>
     <div class="sd-quote" id="resultQuote"></div>
     <p class="sd-desc" id="resultDesc"></p>
     <div class="sd-scores" id="scoreWrap"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sd-acts">
     <a class="sd-main" id="ctaBtn" href="#">Book a free trial with this teacher</a>
     <a class="sd-sub sd-line" id="lineBtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="#">Share on LINE</a>
     <button type="button" class="sd-sub" id="shareBtn">🔗 Share with friends</button>
     <div class="sd-msg" id="shareMsg"></div>
     <button type="button" class="sd-sub" id="sdAgain">Take the quiz again</button>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>
